allowedCandidateChanges: New caption IDs/text/line breaks/source provenance only through exact partitions; no wording changes.
Source milliseconds and segment fields reconstructed from existing saved source records.
144px normal and 192px Scale candidate; non-Panel border/glow 4px DarkSlateGray; Panel appearance retained apart from allowed font/line changes.
Explicit preview motion version; existing motion payload and outer clocks retained.
Left/right protection 4px and horizontal margin 0 in preview only; vertical protection retained.
Old overlay hashes removed from new unmaterialized candidate.
